allNavPages.title: 从Seq2Seq到Attention
allNavPages.summary: 本文先介绍基于 RNN 的 Seq2Seq：编码器将输入序列压缩成固定长度的 context 向量，解码器再逐步生成输出。其主要瓶颈在长序列场景：固定向量容量有限易丢信息，且 RNN 串行计算带来长距离依赖与遗忘。为此引入 Attention：编码器保留所有时间步隐状态，解码器在每一步计算权重并加权求和得到动态 context，从而更精准地关注关键信息并提升效果。

-- 第一步：先找出每个部门最高工资
select deptno,max(sal) as maxsal from emp group by deptno;

-- 第一种：降序排列，取第一行的sal
select sal from emp order by sal desc limit 0,1;
+---------+
| sal     |

-- 第二种：表的自连接
select 
		sal 
from 
		emp 
where 
		sal not in(
				select 
						distinct a.sal 
				from
						emp a 
				join 
						emp b 
				on 
						a.sal < b.sal
				);
5、取得平均薪水最高的部门的部门编号
b

-- 思路1：先按照部门编号分组，求出每个部门的平均薪资，之后按照降序排列，取第一个。
select 
		deptno
from 
		emp
group by
		deptno
order by 
		avg(sal) desc
limit 1;
+--------+
| deptno |
+--------+
|     10 |
+--------+

-- 思路2：先按照部门编号分组，求出每个部门的平均薪资，之后将这张表临时当作t表。取最大值
-- 第一步：找出每个部门的平均薪水
select deptno,avg(sal) as avgsal from emp group by deptno;
+--------+-------------+
| deptno | avgsal      |    t表
+--------+-------------+  
|     10 | 2916.666667 |
|     20 | 2175.000000 |
|     30 | 1566.666667 |
+--------+-------------+

-- 第二步：找出以上结果中avgsal最大的值。
select 
		max(t.avgsal) 
from 
		(select avg(sal) as avgsal from emp group by deptno) t;
+---------------+
| max(t.avgsal) |  v表
+---------------+
|   2916.666667 |
+---------------+

-- 第三步：找出最大值对应的deptno
select 
		v.deptno
from 
		(select deptno,avg(sal) as avgsal from emp group by deptno) v
where
		v.avgsal = (select max(t.avgsal) from (select avg(sal) as avgsal from emp group by deptno) t)
group by 
		deptno;
+--------+
| deptno |
+--------+
|     10 |
+--------+

7、求平均薪水的等级最低的部门的部门名称
b

-- 思路一：先找出每个部门的平均薪资，后按照升序排列，取第一个。
-- 第一步：先找出每个部门的平均薪资
select 
		d.deptno,d.dname,avg(e.sal)
from 
		emp e
join 
		dept d
on
		d.deptno = e.deptno
group by 
		e.deptno;
+--------+------------+-------------+
| deptno | dname      | avg(e.sal)  |   -- t表
+--------+------------+-------------+
|     10 | ACCOUNTING | 2916.666667 |
|     20 | RESEARCH   | 2175.000000 |
|     30 | SALES      | 1566.666667 |
+--------+------------+-------------+

-- 第二步：以上t表和salgrade联接，查找每个平均薪资的等级
select 
		t.*,s.grade
from
		(select 
				d.deptno,d.dname,avg(e.sal) as avgsal
			from 
					emp e
			join 
					dept d
			on
					d.deptno = e.deptno
			group by 
					e.deptno) t
join 
		salgrade s
on 
		t.avgsal between s.losal and s.hisal;
+--------+------------+-------------+-------+
| deptno | dname      | avgsal      | grade |  -- v表
+--------+------------+-------------+-------+ 
|     10 | ACCOUNTING | 2916.666667 |     4 |
|     20 | RESEARCH   | 2175.000000 |     4 |
|     30 | SALES      | 1566.666667 |     3 |
+--------+------------+-------------+-------+

-- 第三步：按照等级升序排列，取第一行
select 
		dname 
from 
		(select 
				t.*,s.grade as v_grade
		from
				(select 
						d.deptno,d.dname,avg(e.sal) as avgsal
					from 
							emp e
					join 
							dept d
					on
							d.deptno = e.deptno
					group by 
							e.deptno) t
		join 
				salgrade s
		on 
				t.avgsal between s.losal and s.hisal) v
order by
		v.v_grade asc
limit 1;
+-------+
| dname |
+-------+
| SALES |
+-------+
